findings.observation: The complete armoured form is visible, but the helmet crest and boot soles sit only about 4–5% from the vertical canvas edges, inside the required 8% safe margin.
One cohesive full set is shown on one featureless charcoal display form, with Head, Torso, Legs, and both Boots clearly readable together and no separate gear.
The enclosed helm, broad layered pauldrons, plate cuirass, articulated arm and leg defenses, and plated boots read immediately as heavy armour.
Overlapping lames, articulated joints, rivets, straps, chainmail gaps, shaped plates, and grounded weight form a plausible protective construction with usable limb coverage.
Blacksteel visibly dominates the helm, torso, limb plates, gauntlets, and boots; dark leather and chainmail remain neutral, subordinate join materials.
Blackened forged plate surfaces with narrow steel-edge reflections and layered riveted articulation establish blacksteel beyond its dark palette.
Material behavior is limited to controlled cold reflections and a restrained warm edge; there is no aura or full-object glow.
The premium realistic painterly finish, honest scratches, controlled highlights, cold key, restrained warm rim, midnight-charcoal backdrop, and dark floor match the accepted profile.

The featureless form transfers no person or published-character resemblance, and there is no rarity rainbow, gold inflation, full-object glow, oversized silhouette, ornament-led material identity, extra gear, text, label, UI, border, frame, logo, or watermark.
